purpose: Prove the open Agent-neutral demand-driven human-Agent collaboration quality harness through goal-level natural-task dogfooding, dynamic capability and task-topology lifecycle arbitration, an accepted methodology and open quality-conformance profile, and thin cross-host reference adapters that reuse sufficient external protocol, runtime, identity, audit, provenance, and evaluation layers.

increments.observedProblem: The user's authorized Chinese README first-screen result remains undelivered after two overcoupled external-candidate routes stopped without producing usable copy, while the current Agent already has the repository facts, writing capability, and bounded edit authority needed to deliver it directly.
increments.hypothesis: A direct current-Agent rewrite limited to the Chinese README first screen can make the product purpose, Agent-owned task topology, product boundary, and honest maturity legible to a newcomer without another model call, capability route, topology change, or user tool-learning burden; the prior material collaboration loss remains attached to the logical demand, so this delivery earns zero O1-O5 credit.
increments.falsifier: The rewrite changes a fixed product fact, hides the unaccepted state, escapes the Chinese first-screen scope, requires a new capability or topology, fails canonical checks, leaves task-owned residue, or the named human rejects the delivered copy.
increments.stopCondition: Stop when one bounded Chinese first-screen rewrite is committed and pushed from the current checkout, canonical verification and residue checks pass, the named human judges the copy, and the outcome-neutral increment either closes and leaves the current graph or stops honestly on the first falsifier; do not promote O1-O5 or retry an external candidate.

deliverables: one directly authored Chinese README first screen with canonical checks, named-human judgment, and zero O1-O5 promotion
